not_used.source: LOWAN (newcomer education locations, PO and VO)
not_used.reason: Disclaimer (https://www.lowan.nl/po/disclaimer/) forbids copying, downloading or distributing site information without written permission. Fetched once to inspect (titles only, no addresses), then deleted; nothing derived from it is in features.json. Newcomer flags come from DUO location names and school websites instead. Ask LOWAN for permission to use their lists.
Answers HTTP 403 to non-browser clients and the IBO terms restrict automated collection; not attempted. IB flags come from DUO (IB programme rows), the DIS list and school websites.
Answers HTTP 403; the Nuffic page above publishes the same network list.
Terms forbid storage and text/data mining (see README).

site_crawl.robots_txt: obeyed (also Crawl-delay, capped at 10 s); unreadable 401/403/5xx robots.txt treated as disallow
site_crawl.rate: max 1 request per second per registrable domain, 8 hosts in parallel
site_crawl.pages_per_site: homepage + at most 5 internal pages chosen by keyword
site_crawl.stored: feature flags and open-day dates with source URL and snippet of at most 150 characters; no page text or images

confidence.high: official or association list, or DUO field
confidence.medium: keyword on a relevant school-site page, or list match at school-group level
confidence.low: keyword only in a menu/link, or on a site that serves several DUO locations (school group or board site): the flag may belong to a sibling location

features.open_days_note: school_year is the school year in which the event takes place (e.g. 2026/27); dates in winter 2026/27 are normally for intake in 2027/28. inferred=true means the page gave no year and the next occurrence of day and month was assumed. Past dates are dropped at build time. Re-run 12/13 close to publication; dates go stale.
features.disclaimer: Feature flags are indications from association lists and school websites, not official classifications. Verify with the school. Not affiliated with the organisations named.
